# Trigger TV display recovery when HDMI-A-1 connector changes state
# This fixes the black screen you get when turning the TV off and back on

ACTION=="change", SUBSYSTEM=="drm", KERNEL=="card1-HDMI-A-1", \
  ENV{DISPLAY}=":0", \
  ENV{XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}="/run/user/1000", \
  ENV DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus", \
  RUN+="/usr/bin/systemd-cat --identifier=recover-tv-display /home/test/.local/bin/recover-tv-display.sh"
